def test_hold_preserves_final_current_and_records_policy(self):
        runner = self.runner(replace(self.parameters, zero_after=False))
        runner.run()
        result = self.outcome[-1]
        self.assertEqual(result['reason'], 'complete')
        self.assertEqual(result['finish_action'], 'held')
        self.assertEqual(self.magnet.current, 1)
        self.assertNotIn('zero', [job for job, _ in self.magnet.calls])
        self.assertEqual(result['metadata']['magnet_finish_requested'], 'hold')
        self.assertFalse(result['metadata']['parameters']['zero_after'])

    def test_single_hold_does_not_change_current(self):
        self.magnet.current = 5
        runner = self.runner(replace(self.parameters, mode='single', zero_after=False))
        runner.run()
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome[-1]['finish_action'], 'held')
        self.assertEqual(self.magnet.current, 5)
        self.assertEqual([job for job, _ in self.magnet.calls], ['read', 'read'])

    def test_stop_overrides_hold(self):
        runner = self.runner(replace(self.parameters, zero_after=False))
        self.lockin.on_sample = runner.stop
        runner.run()
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome[-1]['reason'], 'stopped')
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome[-1]['finish_action'], 'zeroed')
        self.assertEqual(self.magnet.current, 0)

    def test_point_save_error_overrides_hold(self):
        runner = self.runner(replace(self.parameters, zero_after=False))
        with patch('experiment.save_point', side_effect=OSError('disk full')):
            runner.run()
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome[-1]['reason'], 'error')
        self.assertEqual(self.magnet.current, 0)

    def test_figure_export_error_zeros_previously_held_current(self):
        runner = self.runner(replace(self.parameters, zero_after=False))
        with patch('experiment.save_figures', side_effect=OSError('PNG failed')):
            runner.run()
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome[-1]['reason'], 'error')
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome[-1]['finish_action'], 'zeroed')
        self.assertEqual(self.magnet.current, 0)

    def test_stop_during_figure_export_zeros_held_current(self):
        runner = self.runner(replace(self.parameters, zero_after=False))
        with patch('experiment.save_figures', side_effect=lambda *args: runner.stop()):
            runner.run()
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome[-1]['reason'], 'stopped')
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome[-1]['finish_action'], 'zeroed')
        self.assertEqual(self.magnet.current, 0)


if __name__ == '__main__':

import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace

from PyQt5.QtCore import QSettings, Qt, QPoint
from PyQt5.QtGui import QContextMenuEvent
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication

from window import LabWindow


class WindowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
        cls.app.setOrganizationName('LabToolsTests')
        cls.app.setApplicationName('MagneticLabPreferences')
        cls.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        QSettings.setDefaultFormat(QSettings.IniFormat)
        QSettings.setPath(QSettings.IniFormat, QSettings.UserScope, cls.temp.name)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.temp.cleanup()

    def setUp(self):
        QSettings().clear()
        self.windows = []
        self.window = self.make_window()

    def make_window(self):
        window = LabWindow(SimpleNamespace(demo=True, serial=None, timeout=2000, max_frequency=120000))
        self.windows.append(window)
        return window

    def tearDown(self):
        for window in self.windows:
            window.close()
        end = time.perf_counter() + 3
        while time.perf_counter() < end:
            self.app.processEvents()
            if all(w.thread_stopped and not w.mag_thread.isRunning() for w in self.windows):
                break
            time.sleep(.005)
        self.assertTrue(all(w.thread_stopped and not w.mag_thread.isRunning() for w in self.windows))

    def test_right_click_does_not_open_a_numeric_context_menu(self):
        for widget in self.window.default_fields.values():
            self.assertEqual(widget.contextMenuPolicy(), Qt.NoContextMenu)
            self.assertEqual(widget.lineEdit().contextMenuPolicy(), Qt.NoContextMenu)
            event = QContextMenuEvent(QContextMenuEvent.Mouse, QPoint(3, 3), QPoint(3, 3))
            self.app.sendEvent(widget.lineEdit(), event)
        self.assertIsNone(self.app.activePopupWidget())

    def test_button_saves_and_reloads_values_and_end_policy(self):
        w = self.window
        w.slope.setValue(2.5)
        w.offset.setValue(-7)
        w.current_start.setValue(-5)
        w.intervals.setValue(20)
        w.after_measurement.setCurrentIndex(1)
        w.save_defaults_button.click()
        self.assertIn('сохранены', w.defaults_status.text())
        other = self.make_window()
        self.assertEqual(other.slope.value(), 2.5)
        self.assertEqual(other.offset.value(), -7)
        self.assertEqual(other.current_start.value(), -5)
        self.assertEqual(other.intervals.value(), 20)
        self.assertFalse(other.after_measurement.currentData())
        self.assertFalse(other.parameters().zero_after)

    def test_invalid_calibration_is_not_saved_as_default(self):
        w = self.window
        w.slope.setValue(0)
        w.save_defaults_button.click()
        self.assertIn('Не удалось', w.defaults_status.text())
        self.assertFalse(w.settings.contains('defaults/calibration_slope'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
